question.text: 'Narmada Debt AIF' has 3 LPs: Mr. P - INR 60 cr, Mr. Q - INR 30 cr, Mr. R - INR 10 cr. Total commitment INR 100 cr. A drawdown of 40% is called. Calculate Mr. Q's drawdown.

explanation.text: The Logic: Drawdown per LP = 40% x commitment. For Mr. Q: 40% x INR 30 crore = INR 12 crore. The Trap: INR 4 cr uses ~13%. INR 8 cr uses ~27%. INR 16 cr uses ~53%. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests multiple LP pro-rations. XIX-D adds defaulting LP twists. Manager's Pro-Tip: Automate drawdown calculations in your fund administrator's software - manual spreadsheets cause rounding errors that compound across 20+ LP tranches.
